mapper.select: SELECT APT_CMPLEX_NO FROM MGMT_OFFICE WHERE MGMT_OFC_NO = #{mgmtOfcNo} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT MG.USER_NO, M.USER_NM, MG.MGMT_OFC_NO FROM MANAGER MG INNER JOIN MEMBER M ON MG.USER_NO = M.USER_NO WHERE MG.MGMT_OFC_NO = #{mgmtOfcNo} AND M.USER_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY M.USER_NM ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MNGR_VACATION_SCHDL ( VACATION_SCHDL_NO , SCHDL_BGNG_DT , SCHDL_END_DT , SCHDL_TTL , COLOR_CD , REG_DT , USER_NO ) VALUES ( #{scheduleNo} , TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , TO_DATE(#{endDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , #{scheduleTtl} , NVL(#{colorCd}, 'PURPLE') , SYSDATE , #{userNo} )
